column1: # Cohort spec: the 36-row TWO-WITNESS stack-argument ARITY cohort.
# REHEARSED 2026-08-17, NOT PROMOTED.  Another lane held live for the CTentacle
# rename chain while this was authored, so nothing here is a live authorization.
# WHAT THE SECOND WITNESS IS.  Every ABI row in the campaign's 1,001-row
# FLAGGED(ABI) set rested on ONE witness: the RET immediate.  The stack-argument
# slot instrument that landed at 797dcf60 (tools/re_stack_arg_slot_measure.py)
# adds a second, body-derived one: per-basic-block symbolic ESP/EBP tracking that
# resolves every stack memory operand to an incoming argument slot index, so
# `arg_bytes_min` is an exhaustive enumeration of the argument extent the body
# actually touches and never mentions the terminator.  Its independence is
# PROVEN BY CONTROL, not asserted: corrupting the RET immediate does not move the
# measure, and corrupting the frame does.
# MEASURED HERE, twice.  This lane re-derived BOTH witnesses from the pristine
# specimen with a freshly written PE parser, recursive-descent decoder and ESP
# tracker that shares no code with that instrument
# (scratchpad/abi90/verify_bytes.py).  For all 36 rows the independent pass
# reproduces the RET immediate exactly, reproduces `arg_bytes_min` exactly,
# resolves every stack access at an exact delta (zero unresolved, zero indexed,
# zero escaping `lea`), resolves every callee purge, and finds the ESP delta
# exactly 0 at every `ret` - the instrument's own free internal-validity oracle,
# which never mentions the RET immediate.  The section table was parsed rather
# than trusted: .text/.rdata/.data are flat (file offset == VA - 0x400000) and
# .rsrc is NOT, and .data raw ends at VA 0x00661000.
# WHAT THIS COHORT CHANGES, AND WHAT IT REFUSES TO.  Stack ARITY only.  NO
# CALLING CONVENTION IS EVER RELABELLED: `callingConvention` carries the value
# the database already holds, is gated as CURRENT and re-gated as POST, and stays
# a FROZEN collateral column.  35 of the 36 rows are `unknown`, and they stay
# `unknown`: an arity correction is not licence to resolve a convention the bytes
# cannot settle.  No row proposes a register argument, a
# `__return_storage_ptr__`, or a return-type change; `returnTypeProposed` is the
# value already recorded.  33 rows have NO existing parameter at all, so their
# correction is a pure append of `undefined4 param_N` slots.  `col.varArgs` is
# deliberately NOT bound, so varargs stays PRESERVE and stays frozen.
# EVERY EXCLUSION, WITH ITS REASON, is in the companion manifest note and the
# report; the counts are: 1,001 classification rows -> 936 unique addresses ->
# 93 satisfy the stated four-part criterion -> 43 of those were ALREADY
# corrected to exactly this arity by the completed 294-row ceremony (db.18621 ->
# db.18622), leaving 50 -> 11 refused by this framework's own EDX-fabrication
# gate in a measured `dry` run, 2 dropped because the second witness is vacuous
# on them, 1 dropped because its fix needs a simultaneous parameter rename.
# PINS.  Every number below was MEASURED by this framework's own `census` mode on
# a replica restored from D:\BEA-Ghidra-Backups\2026-08-17-tentacle-chain-b-post-live
# (db.18624), which is byte-current with live as of this authoring.  RE-PINNED
# ONCE ALREADY: the first pass measured db.18623 mid-chain, and when ceremony B
# landed exactly three pins moved - preFunctionNameDigest, postFunctionNameDigest
# and preFrozenDigest - while every structural metric, functionBodyDigest,
# bookmarkDigest, definedDataDigest and memoryDigest were byte-identical.  Neither
# tentacle address is one of these 36 targets.  Any further live ceremony must
# re-measure the same way rather than trust these three.
# postFrozenDigest is deliberately NOT pinned - signatureShape, stackParamBytes
# and stackParamCount are frozen columns this verb legitimately moves on its own
# target rows, and the value cannot be computed outside the framework.  The POST
# collateral census still compares every frozen column on all 8,329 rows.
